data.Gordo: None of Gordo's dice can be the same size. Note that a player playing Gordo is required to decline an auxiliary die that would force two of Gordo's dice to be the same size
data.Guillermo: Different swing types must be assigned unique values
data.Oregon: Different swing types must be assigned unique values
data.The Japanese Beetle: Cannot be attacked by skill attacks.
data.RandomBMAnime: 4 normal dice and 4 reserve dice, chosen from standard die sizes.
data.RandomBMDuoskill: Four regular dice and one swing die, and 2 skills each appearing a total of 2 times on various dice.
data.RandomBMFixed: 5 dice, no swing dice, two of them having a single skill chosen from c, f, and d (the same skill on both).
data.RandomBMMixed: 5 dice, no swing dice, three skills chosen from all existing skills except !%+DF`mrw, with each skill dealt out twice randomly and independently over all dice.
data.RandomBMMonoskill: Four regular dice and one swing die, and 1 skill appearing a total of 2 times on various dice.
data.RandomBMPentaskill: Four regular dice and one swing die, and 5 skills each appearing a total of 2 times on various dice.
data.RandomBMSoldiers: A recipe similar to the Soldiers set: Four regular dice and one X swing die, no skills.
data.RandomBMTetraskill: Four regular dice and one swing die, and 4 skills each appearing a total of 2 times on various dice.
data.RandomBMTriskill: Four regular dice and one swing die, and 3 skills each appearing a total of 2 times on various dice.
data.RandomBMVanilla: 5 dice, no swing dice, no skills.
